agent_explanation: Single ball falls under gravity with controller disabled (work=0). Inbound speed at floor contact ~18.3 m/s (steps 89-90, energy ~176 J conserved). After one floor contact step 91, vy is +28.96 m/s upward — larger than inbound despite e=0.5 (expected ~9 m/s) — so kinetic energy more than doubles to 427 J vs allowed ~198 J. Likely cause: floor impulse plus positional/Baumgarte correction adds spurious velocity proportional to impact speed/penetration, injecting energy on high-speed bounce. Counterfactual with same dt/steps but low impact speed shows no energy gain.
